Draw 10 equally spaced vertical ticks, all the same length (44 px), 3 px INK, at x_k = 260 + 160 * (k - 1) for k = 1 to 10 (tick 1 is the leftmost, x = 260; tick 10 is the rightmost, x = 1700). Write a label centred under every tick, 40 px below the axis, left to right: tick 1: 83,705; tick 2: 84,705; tick 3: 85,705; tick 4: 86,705; tick 5: 87,705; tick 6: 88,705; tick 7: 89,705; tick 8: 90,705; tick 9: 91,705; tick 10: 92,705. Labels under ticks 4 and 5 are INK (they are given in the question line); labels under ticks 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are ANSWER. Text height at least 34 px; neighbouring labels must not touch (ticks are 160 px apart).
must_not_show: the part letter a, b, c or d
a circle around the smallest label or a box around the largest label
accuracy_checks: the 10 ticks are equally spaced and all the same length
the given labels stay under the same ticks as in the question line
